es.L: En toda su angustia, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [también] fue angustiado, y el ángel de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia los salvó; \q en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los redimió, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los levantó y los llevó todos los días de antaño.
es.B: Siempre que estaban en apuros, eso {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} angustiaba, y el ángel de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia los rescató. \q En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los redimió; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los alzó y los llevó en brazos a lo largo de los tiempos pasados.
es.R: Cuando ellos sufrían, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sufría con ellos, y el ángel de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia los salvó. \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los amaba y tenía compasión de ellos, los rescató. \q Los alzó y los llevó en brazos durante todos aquellos años de hace mucho tiempo.

fr.L: Dans toute leur détresse, il y a eu pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de la détresse, et l’ange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face les a sauvés ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour et dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} pitié, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rachetés, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a soulevés et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a portés tous les jours d’autrefois.
fr.B: Chaque fois qu’ils étaient dans la détresse, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en était affligé, et l’ange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence les a délivrés. \q Dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} pitié, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rachetés ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a soulevés et portés tout au long des temps anciens.
fr.R: Quand ils souffraient, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} souffrait avec eux, et l’ange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence les a sauvés. \q Parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les aimait et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait pitié d’eux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rachetés. \q Il les a pris et portés pendant toutes les années d’autrefois.

sw.L: Katika dhiki yao yote, {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [ilikuwa] dhiki, na malaika wa uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliwaokoa; \q katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na katika huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliwakomboa, \q naye aliwainua na kuwabeba siku zote za kale.
sw.B: Kila walipokuwa taabuni, ilimtaabisha {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} pia, na malaika wa uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliwaokoa. \q Katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliwakomboa; \q aliwainua na kuwabeba katika nyakati zote za zamani.
sw.R: Walipoteseka, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliteseka pamoja nao, na malaika wa uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliwaokoa. \q Kwa sababu aliwapenda na kuwaonea huruma, aliwanunua tena. \q Aliwainua na kuwabeba miaka yote ile ya zamani.

vi.L: Trong mọi cơn hoạn nạn của họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [cũng] chịu hoạn nạn, và thiên sứ của sự hiện diện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu họ; \q trong tình yêu và lòng thương xót {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc họ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nâng họ lên và bồng ẵm họ suốt những ngày xa xưa.
vi.B: Mỗi khi họ gặp hoạn nạn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đau buồn, và thiên sứ đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu họ. \q Trong tình yêu và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nâng họ lên và bồng ẵm họ suốt những thời xa xưa.
vi.R: Khi họ chịu khổ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng chịu khổ với họ, và thiên sứ của sự hiện diện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu họ. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu thương họ và động lòng thương xót họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chuộc họ lại. \q Ngài đã nâng họ lên và bồng ẵm họ suốt những năm tháng xa xưa.

ko.L: 그들의 모든 고난에 그분도 고난을 당하셨고, 그분의 얼굴의 천사가 그들을 구원했다. \q 그분이 그분의 사랑과 그분의 긍휼로 그들을 구속하시고, \q 옛날 모든 날 동안 그들을 들어 올려 안고 다니셨다.
ko.B: 그들이 고난을 당할 때마다 그분도 괴로워하셨고, 그분의 얼굴의 천사가 그들을 구해 냈다. \q 그분은 그분의 사랑과 긍휼로 그들을 구속하시고, \q 오랜 옛날 내내 그들을 들어 올려 안고 다니셨다.
ko.R: 그들이 고통을 당할 때 그분도 함께 고통을 당하셨다. 그리고 그분의 얼굴의 천사가 그들을 구했다. \q 그분은 그들을 사랑하시고 불쌍히 여기셔서 값을 치르고 그들을 되찾으셨다. \q 그분은 오래전 그 모든 세월 동안 그들을 안아 올려 업고 다니셨다.

pt.L: Em toda a angústia deles, [houve] angústia para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e o anjo da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença os salvou; \q no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor e na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} piedade {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os redimiu, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os levantou e os carregou todos os dias da antiguidade.
pt.B: Sempre que eles estavam em aflição, isso também {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} afligia, e o anjo da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença os livrou. \q No {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor e na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} piedade, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os redimiu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os ergueu e os carregou ao longo de todos os tempos antigos.
pt.R: Quando eles sofriam, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sofria com eles, e o anjo da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença os salvou. \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os amava e tinha pena deles, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os resgatou. \q Ele os pegou no colo e os carregou durante todos aqueles anos antigos.

am.L: በጭንቃቸው ሁሉ እርሱ ተጨነቀ፤ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው፤ \q በፍቅሩና በሐዘኔታው ቤዣቸው፤ \q አነሣቸው፤ በጥንቱም ዘመን ሁሉ ተሸከማቸው።
am.B: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ሁሉ እርሱም ተጨነቀ፤ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው። \q በፍቅሩና በሐዘኔታው ቤዣቸው፤ \q ከጥንት ጀምሮ በዘመናት ሁሉ አንሥቶ ተሸከማቸው።
am.R: መከራ ሲደርስባቸው እርሱም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቸገረ፤ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው። \q ስለሚወዳቸውና ስለሚያዝንላቸው መልሶ ገዛቸው። \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት በዘመናት ሁሉ አንሥቶ ተሸከማቸው።

hi.L: उनके सब संकटों में [परमेश्वर] को [भी] संकट हुआ, और उनकी उपस्थिति के दूत ने उन्हें बचाया; \q अपने प्रेम और अपनी दया में उन्होंने उन्हें छुड़ाया, \q और उन्होंने उन्हें उठाया और प्राचीन काल के सब दिनों में उठाए रखा।
hi.B: जब-जब वे संकट में पड़े, परमेश्वर भी व्याकुल हुए, और उनकी उपस्थिति के दूत ने उन्हें बचाया। \q अपने प्रेम और अपनी दया में उन्होंने उन्हें छुड़ा लिया; \q उन्होंने उन्हें उठा लिया और बीते हुए युगों में सदा उठाए फिरे।
hi.R: जब वे दुख में थे, तब परमेश्वर ने भी उनके साथ दुख उठाया, और उनकी उपस्थिति के दूत ने उन्हें बचाया। \q परमेश्वर उनसे प्रेम करते थे और उन पर तरस खाते थे, इसलिए उन्होंने उन्हें दाम देकर छुड़ा लिया। \q उन्होंने उन्हें उठाया और बहुत पहले के उन सब वर्षों में उन्हें उठाए रहे।

ru.L: Во всякой их скорби — {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} [была] скорбь, и ангел {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} присутствия спас их; \q в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} любви и в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} жалости {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} искупил их, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднял их и носил их все дни древности.
ru.B: Когда они были в беде, это было бедой и для {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, и ангел {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} присутствия избавил их. \q По своей любви и жалости {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} искупил их; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднимал их и носил на руках во все давние времена.
ru.R: Когда они страдали, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} страдал вместе с ними, и ангел {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} присутствия спас их. \q Он любил их и жалел их, и поэтому {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выкупил их. \q Он поднимал их и носил на руках все те давние годы.

ja.L: 彼らのすべての苦しみの中で、その方も苦しまれ、その方の顔の使いが彼らを救った。 \q その愛とあわれみによって、その方は彼らを贖い、 \q 昔のすべての日々、彼らを持ち上げ、担われた。
ja.B: 彼らが苦しむときはいつも、その方も苦しまれ、その方の臨在の使いが彼らを救い出した。 \q その愛とあわれみによって、その方は彼らを贖い、 \q 遠い昔からずっと、彼らを抱き上げて担われた。
ja.R: 彼らが苦しんだとき、その方も共に苦しまれ、その方が共におられることを示す使いが彼らを救った。 \q その方は彼らを愛し、かわいそうに思われたので、彼らを買い戻された。 \q 昔からずっと、彼らを抱き上げて運ばれた。

uk.L: У всякій їхній скруті — {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} [була] скрута, і ангел {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} присутності спас їх; \q у своїй любові і у своєму жалі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} викупив їх, \q і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підняв їх і носив їх усі дні давнини.
uk.B: Щоразу, як вони були в біді, це було бідою і для {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, і ангел {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} присутності рятував їх. \q У своїй любові і своєму жалі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} викупив їх; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підняв їх і носив їх через усі давно минулі віки.
uk.R: Коли вони страждали, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} страждав разом з ними, і ангел {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} присутності спас їх. \q Через те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} любив їх і жалів їх, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} викупив їх. \q Він підняв їх і носив їх усі ті давні роки.

decisions.choice: to him there was distress: the reading tradition (qere), "he was distressed"
alternatives: not an envoy or an angel, but his presence saved them
decisions.reason: The written text (ketiv) has "not" where the reading tradition has "to him"; the two words sound alike. The written text would give "in all their distress he was not an enemy" or "it was no distress". The Septuagint, dividing and voicing the words differently, reads "not an envoy or an angel, but he himself saved them". The reading tradition, followed here, says God shared his people's suffering (Judges 10:16).

decisions.choice: the angel of his presence: the angel in whom God himself went with his people
decisions.reason: At the exodus God sent his angel before Israel, with his own name in him (Exodus 23:20-23), and promised, "My presence will go with you" (Exodus 33:14-15). The word for presence is literally "face".

decisions.choice: lifted them up and carried them: as a parent carries a child
decisions.reason: The same picture is in 46:3-4, Deuteronomy 1:31 and Exodus 19:4.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर" named for "him" (bracketed at Literal)
decisions.reason: God's honorific "वे / उन्हें" has the same form as the plural "they / them" used for the people in this verse, so Hindi names God where the pronoun would leave it unclear whose distress is meant, as the style guide allows.

decisions.choice: "उनकी उपस्थिति का दूत"
decisions.reason: The angel of his presence is the angel in whom God himself went with his people (meaning m2); "उपस्थिति" keeps the link with God's presence going with Israel in Exodus 33:14.

decisions.choice: "ангел его присутствия"
decisions.reason: The angel in whom God himself went with his people (m2); "присутствие" says what "face" means here. Written with a small letter as the English does, since the phrase is not the Pentateuch's "Angel of the LORD".

decisions.choice: lo tsar "その方も苦しまれ", the qere (m1, footnoted); mal'akh panav "その方の顔の使い" (L), "その方の臨在の使い" (B), "その方が共におられることを示す使い" (R): the OT word "使い" for mal'akh (not 天使), the angel in whom God himself went (m2).
decisions.reason: The OT notes' angel word; L keeps "face".

decisions.choice: ge'alam "贖い" (L, B), "買い戻された" (R), as ga'al in ISA-1 / ISA-6.
decisions.reason: The settled redemption verb.

source.text: וְהֵ֛מָּה מָר֥וּ וְעִצְּב֖וּ אֶת־ר֣וּחַ קָדְשׁ֑וֹ וַיֵּהָפֵ֥ךְ לָהֶ֛ם לְאוֹיֵ֖ב ה֥וּא נִלְחַם־בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But they, they rebelled and grieved [the] spirit of his holiness; and he turned himself to them into an enemy; he, he fought against them.

en.L: But they rebelled and grieved {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit; \q so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} turned to become their enemy; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} fought against them.
en.B: But they rebelled and caused {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit grief, \q so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} changed into their enemy and went to war against them {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.
en.R: But they turned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit sad. \q So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became their enemy, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fought against them.

es.L: Pero ellos se rebelaron y entristecieron a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Santo Espíritu; \q por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se volvió su enemigo; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo peleó contra ellos.
es.B: Pero se rebelaron y causaron dolor a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Santo Espíritu, \q así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se convirtió en su enemigo y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo les hizo la guerra.
es.R: Pero se volvieron contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Hicieron que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Santo Espíritu se entristeciera. \q Así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se volvió su enemigo, y peleó contra ellos.

fr.L: Mais eux se sont révoltés et ont attristé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint ; \q alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est changé pour eux en ennemi ; {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} a combattu contre eux.
fr.B: Mais ils se sont révoltés et ont causé du chagrin à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint ; \q alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu leur ennemi et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} fait la guerre.
fr.R: Mais ils se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Ils ont rendu triste {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint. \q Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu leur ennemi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a combattus.

sw.L: Lakini wao waliasi na kumhuzunisha Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Mtakatifu; \q kwa hiyo aligeuka kuwa adui yao; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alipigana nao.
sw.B: Lakini waliasi na kumtia huzuni Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Mtakatifu, \q kwa hiyo aligeuka kuwa adui yao na kwenda vitani dhidi yao {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Lakini walimwasi. Walimhuzunisha Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Mtakatifu. \q Kwa hiyo akawa adui yao, akapigana nao.

vi.L: Nhưng họ đã phản nghịch và làm buồn Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên kẻ thù của họ; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chiến đấu chống lại họ.
vi.B: Nhưng họ đã phản nghịch và làm cho Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} buồn rầu, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành kẻ thù của họ và chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trận đánh họ.
vi.R: Nhưng họ đã chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ đã làm cho Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} buồn. \q Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành kẻ thù của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chiến đấu chống lại họ.

ko.L: 그러나 그들이 반역하여 그분의 거룩한 영을 근심하게 했으므로, \q 그분이 돌이켜 그들의 원수가 되셨고, 그분이 친히 그들과 싸우셨다.

pt.R: Mas eles se voltaram contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Deixaram triste o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito Santo. \q Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou inimigo deles e lutou contra eles.

decisions.choice: grieved his Holy Spirit: God's own Spirit, present among his people, can be grieved
decisions.reason: Literally "the spirit of his holiness"; the phrase is found in the Old Testament only here, in verse 11 and in Psalm 51:13. The Spirit is spoken of as one who can be hurt, as God himself is (Psalm 78:40). Ephesians 4:30 takes up the words: "do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God".

decisions.choice: they rebelled: Israel's rebellion in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Psalm 78:40 and 106:33, 43 describe the same rebellion after the exodus, and Numbers 14 tells it.

decisions.choice: he turned into their enemy: God himself fought against his people
decisions.reason: Their Savior (verse 8) became their opponent, as in Lamentations 2:5, "the Lord has become like an enemy".

decisions.choice: Holy Spirit, with capital letters
decisions.reason: The Spirit is God's own Spirit, so it is written with a capital S, and "of his holiness" is put as "Holy"; compare Ephesians 4:30.

decisions.choice: su Santo Espíritu
decisions.reason: The Spirit is God's own Spirit, so Spanish capitalizes it, as the English does; "Santo Espíritu" keeps the order of the Hebrew phrase "the spirit of his holiness" at every level.

decisions.choice: Roho wake Mtakatifu
decisions.reason: "The spirit of his holiness" is God's own Spirit (meaning decision m1), so Swahili writes "Roho Mtakatifu", the name of the published New Testament, with the possessive of God spanned.

decisions.choice: "Thánh Linh của Ngài"
decisions.reason: "The spirit of his holiness" is rendered as Psalm 51:13 renders the same Hebrew, "Thánh Linh của Ngài", capitalised as the English is.

decisions.choice: "그분의 거룩한 영" with the honorific verb ("근심하게/슬프시게 했다")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "the Spirit of his holiness"; Korean keeps it as a phrase, as the English "his Holy Spirit", and gives the Spirit the honorific verb, as the speakers give it to God.

decisions.choice: entristeceram o seu Espírito Santo (L); Deixaram triste o seu Espírito Santo (R)
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:30 takes up these words (m1), and its Portuguese says "não entristeçam o Espírito Santo" (L, B) and "Não deixem triste o Espírito Santo" (R); Isaiah uses the same verbs at Literal and Readable, so the link can be heard.

decisions.choice: his Holy Spirit "መንፈስ ቅዱሱ" and "grieved" "አሳዘኑ", as Ephesians 4:30 ("መንፈስ ቅዱስ አታሳዝኑ")
alternatives: "የቅድስናው መንፈስ" (the spirit of his holiness), word for word
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:30 echoes this verse, and the Hebrew and the Greek agree on grieving God's Holy Spirit (meaning decision m1). The English marks the name with capitals; Amharic gives it the name the New Testament uses, with the suffix "his".

decisions.choice: "पवित्र आत्मा को शोकित किया" (L), "दुःखी किया" (B, R), masculine, as Ephesians 4:30
decisions.reason: God's own Spirit present among his people can be grieved (meaning m1); Hindi says "पवित्र आत्मा", with masculine agreement as in the New Testament, and the verbs Ephesians 4:30 uses at each level when Paul takes up this verse.

decisions.choice: "लोग" and "परमेश्वर" named
decisions.reason: The people's "they" and God's honorific "वे" look alike in Hindi; Balanced and Readable name each where the verse turns from one to the other.

decisions.choice: "огорчили его Святого Духа"
decisions.reason: "Огорчать" as in Ephesians 4:30, which takes up this line (m1); "Святой Дух" as Psalm 51:13 in this translation. "Сам" takes no span, where the English "himself" has one.

decisions.choice: ruach qodsho "その方の聖なる霊" (every level), as PSA 51:13 "あなたの聖なる霊", not the NT "聖霊", though the English capitalizes it; God's own Spirit who can be grieved (m1), the words EPH 4:30 takes up.
decisions.reason: ISA-1 allows 聖霊 only with a decision; the Psalter's form keeps the OT phrase.

decisions.choice: "засмутили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} Святого Духа"
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:30 echoes this line, "do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God"; "засмутити" is the plain Ukrainian verb for grieving someone and keeps the echo open.

en.L: Then [one] remembered the days of old, Moses, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people: \q "Where [is] the [one who] brought them up from the sea with the shepherds of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock? \q Where [is] the [one who] put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit in its midst,
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people thought back to ancient times, to the days of Moses: \q "Where is the one who brought them, with the shepherds of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, up out of the sea? \q Where is the one who put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit in their midst,
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people remembered what happened long ago, in the time of Moses. \q They asked, "Where is the God who brought them up out of the sea, along with the leaders who cared for them like shepherds? \q Where is the God who put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Holy Spirit among them?

es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo recordó lo que pasó hace mucho tiempo, en tiempos de Moisés. \q Preguntaron: «¿Dónde está el Dios que los sacó del mar, junto con los líderes que los cuidaban como pastores? \q ¿Dónde está el Dios que puso {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Santo Espíritu entre ellos?

fr.L: Alors on s’est souvenu des jours d’autrefois, de Moïse, de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple : \q « Où [est] celui qui les a fait monter de la mer avec les bergers de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau ? \q Où [est] celui qui a mis au milieu d’eux {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint,
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple s’est souvenu des temps anciens, des jours de Moïse : \q « Où est celui qui les a fait remonter de la mer, avec les bergers de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau ? \q Où est celui qui a mis {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint au milieu d’eux,
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple s’est souvenu de ce qui s’était passé il y a longtemps, au temps de Moïse. \q Ils ont demandé : « Où est le Dieu qui les a fait sortir de la mer, avec les chefs qui prenaient soin d’eux comme des bergers ? \q Où est le Dieu qui a mis {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit saint au milieu d’eux ?

vi.L: Bấy giờ [người ta] nhớ lại những ngày xa xưa, [thời] Môi-se, dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: \q "Đấng đã đem họ lên khỏi biển cùng với những người chăn bầy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] đâu? \q Đấng đã đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa họ [ở] đâu,
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại thời xa xưa, những ngày của Môi-se: \q "Đấng đã đem họ cùng những người chăn bầy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên khỏi biển ở đâu? \q Đấng đã đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa họ ở đâu,
vi.R: Bấy giờ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại những việc đã xảy ra từ lâu, vào thời Môi-se. \q Họ hỏi: "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã đem họ lên khỏi biển cùng với những người lãnh đạo chăm sóc họ như người chăn chiên, ở đâu? \q Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa họ, ở đâu?

ko.L: 그때 [그분의 백성이] 옛날, 모세와 그분의 백성의 [때를] 기억했다. \q "그분의 양 떼의 목자들과 함께 그들을 바다에서 이끌어 올리신 분이 어디 계시냐? \q 그들 가운데 그분의 거룩한 영을 두신 분이 어디 계시냐?
ko.B: 그때 그분의 백성이 옛날, 모세의 때를 돌이켜 생각했다. \q "그분의 양 떼의 목자들과 함께 그들을 바다에서 이끌어 올리신 분이 어디 계시냐? \q 그들 가운데 그분의 거룩한 영을 두신 분이 어디 계시냐?
ko.R: 그때 그분의 백성은 오래전 모세의 때에 있었던 일을 기억했다. \q 그들이 물었다. "그들을 바다에서 이끌어 올리신 하나님, 목자처럼 그들을 돌본 지도자들과 함께 그렇게 하신 하나님은 어디 계시냐? \q 그들 가운데 그분의 거룩한 영을 두신 하나님은 어디 계시냐?

pt.L: Então [alguém] se lembrou dos dias antigos, de Moisés, do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo: \q "Onde [está] aquele que os fez subir do mar com os pastores do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho? \q Onde [está] aquele que pôs no meio dele o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito Santo,
pt.B: Então o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo se lembrou dos tempos antigos, dos dias de Moisés: \q "Onde está aquele que os fez subir do mar com os pastores do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho? \q Onde está aquele que pôs o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito Santo no meio deles,
pt.R: Então o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo se lembrou do que aconteceu muito tempo atrás, no tempo de Moisés. \q Eles perguntaram: "Onde está o Deus que os tirou do mar, junto com os líderes que cuidavam deles como pastores? \q Onde está o Deus que pôs o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito Santo no meio deles?

am.L: የቀድሞውንም ዘመን፣ ሙሴንና ሕዝቡን አሰበ፦ \q «ከመንጋው እረኞች ጋር ከባሕር ያወጣቸው የት [አለ]? \q መንፈስ ቅዱሱን በመካከሉ ያኖረው የት [አለ]፣
am.B: ከዚያም ሕዝቡ የጥንቱን ዘመን፣ የሙሴን ዘመን አሰቡ፦ \q «ከመንጋው እረኞች ጋር ከባሕር ያወጣቸው የት አለ? \q መንፈስ ቅዱሱን በመካከላቸው ያኖረው የት አለ፣
am.R: ከዚያም ሕዝቡ በሙሴ ዘመን ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት የሆነውን አሰቡ። \q እንዲህም ብለው ጠየቁ፦ «እንደ እረኛ ከሚንከባከቧቸው መሪዎች ጋር ከባሕር ያወጣቸው አምላክ የት አለ? \q መንፈስ ቅዱሱን በመካከላቸው ያኖረው አምላክ የት አለ?

hi.L: तब [किसी] ने प्राचीन दिनों को, मूसा को, उनकी प्रजा को स्मरण किया: \q "कहाँ [हैं] वे जो उन्हें अपनी भेड़ों के चरवाहों के साथ समुद्र से निकाल लाए? \q कहाँ [हैं] वे जिन्होंने उसके बीच अपना पवित्र आत्मा डाला,
hi.B: तब उनकी प्रजा ने प्राचीन समय को, मूसा के दिनों को स्मरण किया: \q "कहाँ हैं वे जो उन्हें अपनी भेड़ों के चरवाहों के साथ समुद्र में से निकाल लाए? \q कहाँ हैं वे जिन्होंने उनके बीच अपना पवित्र आत्मा रखा,
hi.R: तब उनकी प्रजा ने याद किया कि बहुत पहले, मूसा के समय में, क्या हुआ था। \q उन्होंने पूछा, "कहाँ हैं वे परमेश्वर जो उन्हें समुद्र में से निकाल लाए, उन अगुवों के साथ जो चरवाहों की तरह उनकी देखभाल करते थे? \q कहाँ हैं वे परमेश्वर जिन्होंने उनके बीच अपना पवित्र आत्मा रखा?

ru.L: И вспомнил [народ] дни древности, Моисея, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ: \q «Где выведший их из моря с пастухами {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} стада? \q Где вложивший в его среду {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Святого Духа,
ru.B: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ вспомнил древние времена, дни Моисея: \q «Где тот, кто вывел их из моря вместе с пастухами {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} стада? \q Где тот, кто вложил своего Святого Духа в их среду,
ru.R: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ вспомнил, что было давным-давно, во времена Моисея. \q Они спрашивали: «Где Бог, который вывел их из моря вместе с вождями, заботившимися о них, как пастухи? \q Где Бог, который поселил среди них своего Святого Духа?

ja.L: そのとき、[人は]昔の日々、モーセ、その民を思い起こした。 \q 「彼らを、その群れの羊飼いたちと共に、海から導き上った方は、どこにおられるのか。 \q その中にご自分の聖なる霊を置かれた方、
ja.B: そのとき、その民は昔を、モーセの時代を思い起こした。 \q 「その群れの羊飼いたちと共に、彼らを海から導き上った方は、どこにおられるのか。 \q 彼らのただ中に、ご自分の聖なる霊を置かれた方、
ja.R: そのとき、その方の民は、モーセの時代に起こった昔のことを思い出した。 \q 彼らは尋ねた。「ご自分の民を羊飼いのように世話する指導者たちと共に、彼らを海から導き上った神は、どこにおられるのか。 \q ご自分の聖なる霊を彼らの中に置かれた神は、どこにおられるのか。

uk.L: Тоді [хтось] згадав дні давнини, Мойсея, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} народ: \q «Де [той, хто] вивів їх з моря з пастирями своєї отари? \q Де [той, хто] вклав свого Святого Духа посеред нього,
uk.B: Тоді {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} народ згадав давні часи, дні Мойсея: \q «Де той, хто вивів їх з моря разом із пастирями своєї отари? \q Де той, хто вклав свого Святого Духа посеред них,
uk.R: Тоді {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} народ згадав те, що сталося давно, за часів Мойсея. \q Вони питали: «Де той Бог, що вивів їх з моря разом із провідниками, що дбали про них, як пастирі? \q Де той Бог, що вклав свого Святого Духа серед них?

decisions.choice: he remembered: his people remembered, and asked where God had gone
alternatives: God remembered the days of old
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, and "his people" can be its subject (a people spoken of as one). The questions that follow look for God, so they are the people's words. The subject could instead be God, who remembered the old days; then the questions are his. The Hebrew does not say.

decisions.choice: the shepherds of his flock: the received text (plural), Moses and Aaron
decisions.reason: Psalm 77:21 says God led his people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron, and Micah 6:4 names Moses, Aaron and Miriam. Some manuscripts and the Septuagint have the singular "shepherd", meaning Moses; Hebrews 13:20 seems to echo that form.

decisions.choice: put his Holy Spirit among them: God's Spirit with Israel in the wilderness
decisions.reason: God put his Spirit on the seventy elders (Numbers 11:17, 25), and Haggai 2:5 recalls that his Spirit stood among them when they came out of Egypt. Nehemiah 9:20 speaks of his good Spirit given to teach them.

decisions.choice: his people thought back, to the days of Moses; They asked
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the subject chosen in the meaning decision and introduce the questions as the people's words.

decisions.choice: the God who brought them up; the leaders who cared for them like shepherds
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one asked about and explains the shepherds as leaders.

decisions.choice: "አሰበ" (he remembered) with no subject named
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say who remembered (meaning decision m1); the Amharic verb, like the Hebrew, carries its subject in itself, so Literal leaves it open where the English Literal says "[one]". Balanced and Readable name the people, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "कहाँ हैं वे": honorific forms for God in the people's question
decisions.reason: The people speak about God, not yet to him, so he takes the honorific third person; the prayer turns to "तू" in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "вспомнил [народ]"
decisions.reason: The one who remembers is his people (m1); Literal supplies the subject in brackets.

decisions.choice: The second question ("Where is the one who put his Holy Spirit …") runs on through 63:12-13 as a chain of descriptions ("……置かれた方、……名を得られた方、……歩ませた方は"), and closes in 63:13 with "どこにおられるのか" and the closing bracket, as the English quotation does; R closes each question in its own verse, as its English.
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the head noun after its descriptions.

decisions.choice: vayyizkor "[人は]……思い起こした" (L), "その民は" (B, R), the reading of m1 (footnoted); the people speak of God with respect forms ("おられる", "置かれた"); ro'ei tso'no plural "羊飼いたち", the received text (m2).
decisions.reason: Follows the meaning decisions.

source.text: מוֹלִיךְ֙ לִימִ֣ין מֹשֶׁ֔ה זְר֖וֹעַ תִּפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ בּ֤וֹקֵֽעַ מַ֨יִם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ שֵׁ֥ם עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [who] caused to go at [the] right hand of Moses [the] arm of his splendor, [who] split [the] waters before them to make for himself a name of perpetuity,

en.L: [who] caused {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} splendid arm to go at the right hand of Moses, \q [who] split the waters before them \q to make for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} an everlasting name,
en.B: who made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious arm march at Moses' right side, \q who split the waters in front of them \q to win {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} a name that lasts forever,
en.R: He sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious power to go along with Moses. \q He split the sea in two in front of them. \q He did it to make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name famous forever.

es.L: [el que] hizo ir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} glorioso brazo a la diestra de Moisés, \q [el que] dividió las aguas delante de ellos \q para hacerse un nombre eterno,
es.B: el que hizo marchar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} glorioso brazo al lado derecho de Moisés, \q el que partió las aguas delante de ellos \q para ganarse un nombre que dura para siempre,
es.R: Envió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} glorioso poder para que acompañara a Moisés. \q Partió el mar en dos delante de ellos. \q Lo hizo para que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre fuera famoso para siempre.

fr.L: [celui qui] a fait aller {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras glorieux à la droite de Moïse, \q [qui] a fendu les eaux devant eux \q pour se faire un nom éternel,
fr.B: qui a fait marcher {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras glorieux à la droite de Moïse, \q qui a fendu les eaux devant eux \q pour s’acquérir un nom qui dure toujours,
fr.R: Il a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance glorieuse accompagner Moïse. \q Il a fendu la mer en deux devant eux. \q Il l’a fait pour rendre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom célèbre pour toujours.

sw.L: [aliyeufanya] mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa fahari uende mkono wa kuume wa Musa, \q [aliyeyapasua] maji mbele yao \q ili kujifanyia jina la milele,
sw.B: aliyeufanya mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa utukufu utembee upande wa kuume wa Musa, \q aliyeyapasua maji mbele yao \q ili kujipatia jina linalodumu milele,
sw.R: Aliutuma uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtukufu uende pamoja na Musa. \q Aliigawa bahari pande mbili mbele yao. \q Alifanya hivyo ili jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} lijulikane milele.

vi.L: [Đấng] đã khiến cánh tay vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi bên tay phải Môi-se, \q [Đấng] đã rẽ nước trước mặt họ \q để làm cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh đời đời,
vi.B: Đấng đã cho cánh tay vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi bên phải Môi-se, \q Đấng đã rẽ nước ra trước mặt họ \q để làm nên cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh còn mãi đời đời,
vi.R: Ngài đã sai quyền năng vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi cùng Môi-se. \q Ngài đã rẽ biển làm hai trước mặt họ. \q Ngài làm điều đó để danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được nổi tiếng mãi mãi.

ko.L: 그분의 영광스러운 팔이 모세의 오른편에서 함께 가게 하시고, \q 그들 앞에서 물을 가르셔서 \q 그분의 영원한 이름을 내신 분,
ko.B: 그분의 영광스러운 팔이 모세의 오른편에서 함께 나아가게 하시고, \q 그들 앞에서 바닷물을 가르셔서 \q 영원히 남을 이름을 얻으신 분,
ko.R: 그분은 그분의 영광스러운 능력을 모세와 함께 보내셨다. \q 그분은 그들 앞에서 바다를 둘로 가르셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 이름이 영원히 알려지게 하려고 그렇게 하셨다.

pt.L: [aquele que] fez andar à direita de Moisés o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} braço glorioso, \q [que] dividiu as águas diante deles \q para fazer para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um nome eterno,
pt.B: que fez o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} braço glorioso marchar ao lado direito de Moisés, \q que dividiu as águas diante deles \q para conquistar para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um nome que dura para sempre,
pt.R: Ele mandou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder glorioso acompanhar Moisés. \q Ele dividiu o mar em dois diante deles. \q Fez isso para tornar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome famoso para sempre.

am.L: ክብሩ የሆነውን ክንዱን በሙሴ ቀኝ ያስኬደው፣ \q ውኆቹን በፊታቸው የከፈለው፣ \q ለራሱ የዘላለም ስም ያደርግ ዘንድ፣
am.B: ክብራማ ክንዱን በሙሴ ቀኝ ያስኬደው፣ \q ውኆቹን በፊታቸው የከፈለው፣ \q ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስም ለራሱ ያገኝ ዘንድ፣
am.R: ክብራማ ኃይሉን ከሙሴ ጋር ላከ። \q ባሕሩን በፊታቸው ለሁለት ከፈለ። \q ይህንም ያደረገው ስሙ ለዘላለም የታወቀ እንዲሆን ነው።

hi.L: [जिन्होंने] अपनी प्रतापी भुजा को मूसा के दाहिने हाथ चलाया, \q [जिन्होंने] उनके आगे जल को चीर दिया \q कि अपने लिए सदा का नाम करें,
hi.B: जिन्होंने अपनी महिमामय भुजा को मूसा के दाहिनी ओर चलाया, \q जिन्होंने उनके सामने जल को दो भाग कर दिया \q कि अपने लिए ऐसा नाम कमाएँ जो सदा बना रहे,
hi.R: उन्होंने अपनी महिमामय शक्ति को मूसा के साथ भेजा। \q उन्होंने उनके सामने समुद्र को दो भागों में बाँट दिया। \q उन्होंने यह इसलिए किया कि उनका नाम सदा के लिए प्रसिद्ध हो जाए।

ru.L: [который] повёл по правую руку Моисея {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славную руку, \q [который] рассёк воды перед ними, \q чтобы сделать себе вечное имя,
ru.B: кто заставил свою славную руку идти по правую сторону от Моисея, \q кто рассёк воды перед ними, \q чтобы приобрести себе имя, которое пребудет вечно,
ru.R: Он послал свою славную силу идти вместе с Моисеем. \q Он разделил море надвое перед ними. \q Он сделал это, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя прославилось навеки.

ja.L: モーセの右に、ご自分の輝かしい腕を行かせ、 \q 彼らの前で水を裂き、 \q ご自分のためにとこしえの名を得られた方、
ja.B: モーセの右に、ご自分の栄光の腕を進ませ、 \q 彼らの前で水を二つに分け、 \q 永遠に続く名をご自分のために得られた方、
ja.R: その方は、ご自分の栄光ある力をモーセと共に行かせられた。 \q 彼らの前で、海を二つに分けられた。 \q そうして、ご自分の名をいつまでも知れ渡らせられた。

uk.L: [що] дав своєму славному раменові йти при правиці Мойсея, \q [що] розділив води перед ними, \q щоб зробити собі вічне імʼя,
uk.B: що дав своєму славному раменові йти при правиці Мойсея, \q що розколов води перед ними, \q щоб здобути собі імʼя, яке триває вічно,
uk.R: Він послав свою славну силу йти разом із Мойсеєм. \q Він розділив море надвоє перед ними. \q Він зробив це, щоб {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя стало славним навіки.

decisions.choice: his glorious arm at Moses' right hand: God's power working alongside Moses
decisions.reason: When Moses stretched out his hand and staff, God's power did the work (Exodus 14:16, 21; 17:11). The arm stands for that power (verse 5).

decisions.choice: split the waters: the crossing of the sea at the exodus
decisions.reason: Exodus 14:21; Psalm 78:13; Nehemiah 9:11. The same verb is used in those passages.

decisions.choice: an everlasting name: a reputation that lasts forever
decisions.reason: God's deeds at the exodus made his name known among the nations (Exodus 9:16; Nehemiah 9:10; 55:13).

decisions.choice: He sent ... He split ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the chain of descriptions after "Where is the God who" into short statements about him; the questions of verse 11 still govern them.

decisions.choice: zeroa' tif'arto "ご自分の輝かしい腕" (L), "栄光の腕" (B), "栄光ある力" (R): God's power at Moses' side (m1); boqea' mayim "水を裂き" (L), "水を二つに分け" (B) (m2).
decisions.reason: L keeps tif'eret as 輝き.

source.text: מוֹלִיכָ֖ם בַּתְּהֹמ֑וֹת כַּסּ֥וּס בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [who] caused them to walk through the depths? Like a horse in the wilderness, not they stumbled.

en.L: [who] led them through the depths? \q Like a horse in the wilderness, they did not stumble."
en.B: who guided them through the depths, \q so that they did not stumble, sure-footed as a horse on the open plain?"
en.R: He led them through the deep water. \q They did not trip or fall. They were like a horse running easily across a desert plain."

es.L: [el que] los condujo por los abismos? \q Como un caballo en el desierto, no tropezaron».
es.B: el que los guio por las profundidades, \q de modo que no tropezaron, seguros como un caballo en la llanura abierta?».
es.R: Los guio por el agua profunda. \q No tropezaron ni cayeron. Eran como un caballo que corre con facilidad por una llanura desierta».

fr.L: [qui] les a fait marcher à travers les abîmes ? \q Comme un cheval dans le désert, ils n’ont pas trébuché. »
fr.B: qui les a guidés à travers les abîmes, \q sans qu’ils trébuchent, d’un pas sûr comme un cheval dans la plaine ? »
fr.R: Il les a conduits à travers les eaux profondes. \q Ils n’ont ni trébuché ni chuté. Ils étaient comme un cheval qui court facilement dans une plaine du désert. »

sw.L: [aliyewaongoza] kupitia vilindi? \q Kama farasi nyikani, hawakujikwaa."
sw.B: aliyewaongoza kupitia vilindi, \q hata hawakujikwaa, wakienda imara kama farasi katika uwanda ulio wazi?"
sw.R: Aliwaongoza kupitia maji marefu. \q Hawakujikwaa wala kuanguka. Walikuwa kama farasi anayekimbia kwa urahisi katika uwanda wa jangwa."

vi.L: [Đấng] đã dẫn họ đi qua các vực sâu? \q Như ngựa trong đồng hoang, họ đã không vấp ngã."
vi.B: Đấng đã dẫn họ đi qua vực sâu, \q để họ không vấp ngã, vững chân như ngựa trên đồng trống?"
vi.R: Ngài đã dẫn họ đi qua nước sâu. \q Họ không vấp hay ngã. Họ như con ngựa chạy nhẹ nhàng trên đồng bằng sa mạc."

ko.L: 그들을 깊은 물 가운데로 걷게 하신 분이 [어디 계시냐]? \q 광야의 말처럼 그들이 넘어지지 않았다."
ko.B: 그들을 깊은 바다 가운데로 이끄셔서, \q 들판을 달리는 말처럼 그들이 넘어지지 않게 하신 분이 어디 계시냐?"
ko.R: 그분은 깊은 물 가운데로 그들을 이끄셨다. \q 그들은 걸려 넘어지지 않았다. 그들은 사막 평원을 쉽게 달리는 말과 같았다."

pt.L: [que] os conduziu pelos abismos? \q Como um cavalo no deserto, eles não tropeçaram."
pt.B: que os guiou pelas profundezas, \q de modo que não tropeçaram, firmes como um cavalo em campo aberto?"
pt.R: Ele os levou pelas águas profundas. \q Eles não tropeçaram nem caíram. Eram como um cavalo que corre com facilidade por uma planície do deserto."

am.L: በጥልቆቹ ውስጥ የመራቸው [የት አለ]? \q በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ፈረስ አልተሰናከሉም።»
am.B: በጥልቁ ውስጥ የመራቸው፣ \q በሜዳ ላይ እንደሚሮጥ ፈረስ ሳይሰናከሉ እንዲሄዱ ያደረጋቸው የት አለ?»
am.R: በጥልቁ ውኃ ውስጥ መራቸው። \q አልተደናቀፉም፤ አልወደቁምም። በምድረ በዳ ሜዳ ላይ ያለ ችግር እንደሚሮጥ ፈረስ ነበሩ።»

hi.L: [जो] उन्हें गहरे जल में से ले चले? \q निर्जन प्रदेश में घोड़े के समान, वे ठोकर न खाते थे।"
hi.B: जो उन्हें गहरे जल में से ले चले, \q कि वे ठोकर न खाएँ, जैसे खुले मैदान में घोड़ा मज़बूती से पाँव रखता है?"
hi.R: वे उन्हें गहरे पानी में से ले चले। \q वे न ठोकर खाए, न गिरे। वे उस घोड़े के समान थे जो सुनसान मैदान में आसानी से दौड़ता है।"

ru.L: [который] провёл их через пучины? \q Как конь в пустыне, они не спотыкались.»
ru.B: кто провёл их через пучины, \q так что они не спотыкались, уверенно ступая, как конь по открытой равнине?»
ru.R: Он провёл их через глубокие воды. \q Они не спотыкались и не падали. Они были как конь, который легко бежит по степи.»

ja.L: 深淵の中を彼らに歩ませた方は、[どこにおられるのか]。 \q 荒れ野の馬のように、彼らはつまずかなかった。」
ja.B: 深い水の底を通って彼らを導き、 \q 平原を行く馬のように、つまずくこともなくさせた方は、どこにおられるのか。」
ja.R: その方は、深い水の中を通って、彼らを導かれた。 \q 彼らはつまずくことも、倒れることもなかった。砂漠の平原を楽々と走る馬のようだった。」

uk.L: [що] провів їх через безодні? \q Як кінь у пустелі, вони не спіткнулися.»
uk.B: що провів їх через безодні, \q так що вони не спіткнулися, ступаючи впевнено, як кінь на відкритій рівнині?»
uk.R: Він провів їх через глибокі води. \q Вони не спіткнулися і не впали. Вони були, як кінь, що легко біжить по рівнині в пустелі.»

decisions.choice: the depths: the deep waters of the sea at the exodus
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the sea Israel crossed in 51:10 and Exodus 15:5, 8.

decisions.choice: like a horse in the wilderness: sure-footed, on easy ground
decisions.reason: The wilderness here is open grazing land, where a horse runs without tripping. The sea bed was as easy as open ground (Psalm 106:9, "through the deep as through a wilderness").

decisions.choice: so that they did not stumble, sure-footed as a horse
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the line inside the question and puts the comparison last, where it explains the stumbling.

decisions.choice: the question "የት አለ?" (where is) closes the sentence that runs from 63:11
decisions.reason: Amharic puts the relative clauses ("who brought them up ... who split the waters ... who led them") before the question word, so the last of them carries "where is he?"; Literal brackets it because the Hebrew says it only in verse 11.

decisions.choice: tehomot "深淵" (L), "深い水" (B, R), the sea of the exodus (m1); bammidbar "荒れ野" (L), "平原" (B), "砂漠の平原" (R), open, easy ground (m2).
decisions.reason: The settled midbar words at L; B and R give the sense.

source.text: כַּבְּהֵמָה֙ בַּבִּקְעָ֣ה תֵרֵ֔ד ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה תְּנִיחֶ֑נּוּ כֵּ֚ן נִהַ֣גְתָּ עַמְּךָ֔ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְךָ֖ שֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאָֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: Like livestock [that] into the valley goes down, [the] spirit of Yahweh gave him rest. So you led your people to make for yourself a name of splendor.

en.L: Like livestock [that] go down into the valley, \q the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest. \q So {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} led {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, to make for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} a name of splendor.
en.B: As cattle make their way down into a valley, \q the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought them to rest. \q In this way {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} guided {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, to make for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} a name full of splendor.
en.R: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} led them to a place of rest, the way cattle walk down into a valley to rest. \q That is how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} led {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people. \q You did it so that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name would be honored and praised.

es.L: Como el ganado [que] desciende al valle, \q el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} les dio descanso. \q Así guiaste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, para ganar para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} un nombre glorioso.
es.B: Como el ganado que baja al valle, \q el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los llevó al descanso. \q Así guiaste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, para ganar para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} un nombre lleno de esplendor.
es.R: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los llevó a un lugar de descanso, como el ganado que baja al valle para descansar. \q Así guiaste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo. \q Lo hiciste para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre fuera honrado y alabado.

fr.L: Comme le bétail [qui] descend dans la vallée, \q l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les a fait reposer. \q Ainsi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as conduit {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} faire un nom de splendeur.
fr.B: Comme le bétail descend dans la vallée, \q l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les a menés au repos. \q C’est ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as guidé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} faire un nom plein de splendeur.
fr.R: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les a conduits à un lieu de repos, comme le bétail descend dans une vallée pour se reposer. \q C’est ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as conduit {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. \q Tu l’as fait pour que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom soit honoré et loué.

sw.L: Kama mifugo [inayoshuka] bondeni, \q Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa pumziko. \q Ndivyo ulivyowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili kujifanyia jina la fahari.
sw.B: Kama ng'ombe wanavyoshuka bondeni, \q Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafikisha mahali pa pumziko. \q Ndivyo ulivyowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili kujifanyia jina lililojaa fahari.
sw.R: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaongoza mpaka mahali pa pumziko, kama ng'ombe wanavyoshuka bondeni kupumzika. \q Ndivyo ulivyowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Ulifanya hivyo ili jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liheshimiwe na kusifiwa.

vi.L: Như gia súc đi xuống thung lũng, \q Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cho họ an nghỉ. \q Ngài đã dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế, để làm cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh vinh hiển.
vi.B: Như đàn bò đi xuống thung lũng, \q Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đưa họ đến chốn nghỉ ngơi. \q Ngài đã dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế, để làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh đầy vinh hiển.
vi.R: Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dẫn họ đến nơi an nghỉ, như đàn bò đi xuống thung lũng để nghỉ. \q Ngài đã dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như vậy. \q Ngài làm điều đó để danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn kính và ca ngợi.

ko.L: 골짜기로 내려가는 가축처럼 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그들을 쉬게 하셨습니다. \q 이와 같이 주님께서 주님의 백성을 인도하셔서 영광스러운 이름을 내셨습니다.
ko.B: 가축이 골짜기로 내려가듯이 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그들에게 쉼을 주셨습니다. \q 이처럼 주님께서는 주님의 백성을 이끄셔서 영광이 가득한 이름을 얻으셨습니다.
ko.R: 소 떼가 쉬려고 골짜기로 내려가듯이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그들을 쉴 곳으로 이끄셨습니다. \q 주님께서는 그렇게 주님의 백성을 이끄셨습니다. \q 주님께서 그렇게 하신 것은 주님의 이름이 높임과 찬양을 받게 하시려는 것이었습니다.

pt.L: Como o gado [que] desce ao vale, \q o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} lhes deu descanso. \q Assim {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conduziste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, para fazer para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome de esplendor.
pt.B: Como o gado que desce para o vale, \q o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} os levou ao descanso. \q Desse modo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guiaste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, para fazer para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome cheio de esplendor.
pt.R: O Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} os levou a um lugar de descanso, como o gado desce até um vale para descansar. \q Foi assim que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guiaste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo. \q Fizeste isso para que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome fosse honrado e louvado.

am.L: ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ ከብቶች፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ አሳረፋቸው። \q እንዲሁ ለራስህ የክብር ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ ሕዝብህን መራህ።
am.B: ከብቶች ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ ወደ ዕረፍት አመጣቸው። \q በዚህ ሁኔታ ለራስህ የክብር ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ ሕዝብህን መራህ።
am.R: ከብቶች ለማረፍ ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ ወደ ማረፊያ ስፍራ መራቸው። \q ሕዝብህን የመራኸው እንደዚህ ነው። \q ይህንም ያደረግኸው ስምህ እንዲከበርና እንዲመሰገን ነው።

hi.L: जैसे पशु घाटी में उतर जाते हैं, \q [वैसे ही] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के आत्मा ने उन्हें विश्राम दिया। \q इसी प्रकार तूने अपनी प्रजा की अगुवाई की, कि अपने लिए महिमामय नाम करे।
hi.B: जैसे मवेशी उतरकर घाटी में जाते हैं, \q वैसे ही {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के आत्मा ने उन्हें विश्राम तक पहुँचाया। \q इसी रीति से तूने अपनी प्रजा का मार्गदर्शन किया, कि अपने लिए वैभव से भरा नाम बनाए।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आत्मा उन्हें विश्राम की जगह तक ले गया, जैसे मवेशी आराम करने के लिए घाटी में उतर जाते हैं। \q तूने अपनी प्रजा की अगुवाई इसी तरह की। \q तूने यह इसलिए किया कि तेरे नाम का आदर हो और उसकी स्तुति हो।

ru.L: Как скот, [что] спускается в долину, \q Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} дал им покой. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вёл {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ, чтобы сделать себе славное имя.
ru.B: Как стадо спускается в долину, \q так Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} привёл их к покою. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вёл {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ, чтобы сделать себе имя, полное славы.
ru.R: Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} привёл их к месту покоя, как скот спускается в долину, чтобы отдохнуть. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вёл {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ. \q Ты делал это, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя почитали и прославляли.

ja.L: 谷に下る家畜のように、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の霊が彼らを憩わせてくださった。 \q このように、あなたはご自分の民を導き、ご自分のために輝かしい名を得られた。
ja.B: 牛の群れが谷へ下って行くように、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の霊は彼らを休ませてくださった。 \q このようにして、あなたはご自分の民を導き、輝きに満ちた名をご自分のものとされた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の霊は、牛が谷に下りて休むように、彼らを休み場所に導いてくださった。 \q このようにして、あなたはご自分の民を導かれた。 \q それは、あなたの名があがめられ、たたえられるためだった。

uk.L: Як худоба, [що] сходить у долину, \q Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} дав їм спочинок. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вів свій народ, щоб зробити собі славне імʼя.
uk.B: Як худоба спускається в долину, \q так Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} привів їх до спочинку. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вів свій народ, щоб зробити собі імʼя, повне слави.
uk.R: Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} привів їх до місця спочинку, як худоба сходить у долину, щоб відпочити. \q Ось як {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вів свій народ. \q Ти зробив це, щоб {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя шанували і хвалили.

decisions.choice: gave them rest: the received text
decisions.reason: The Septuagint and some other ancient versions have "guided them", a verb that differs by one letter and matches "you led" in the next line. The received text speaks of the rest God gave Israel in the land (Deuteronomy 12:9-10; Joshua 21:44).

decisions.choice: livestock going down into the valley: to water and pasture at the end of the day
decisions.reason: Herds were driven down from the dry hills to the valley floor, where there was water and grass. The picture is of Israel brought safely to rest.

decisions.choice: you led your people: the prayer now speaks to God directly
decisions.reason: From here to 64:11 the prayer addresses God as "you".

decisions.choice: The Spirit of the LORD led them to a place of rest, the way cattle walk down into a valley
decisions.reason: Readable puts the main statement first and the comparison second.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA"
decisions.reason: "The Spirit of the LORD" keeps the Old Testament form "Thần Linh", as at 61:1 and in 2 Samuel 23:2; the address turns to God here ("you" in Hebrew), and Vietnamese, which addresses God as "Ngài" just as it speaks of him, needs no change of pronoun.

decisions.choice: the prayer turns to God here in 합쇼체 with "주님", and the rest of the prayer (63:15-64:11) keeps it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to "you" in the middle of the verse (m3); Korean marks the turn with the polite ending from the whole verse on, so that the verse does not change speech level in mid-sentence.

decisions.choice: tu, teu, ti (the prayer to God, 63:14-64:11)
decisions.reason: From here the prayer speaks to God directly (m3), so it says "tu" at every level with the deity_pronoun setting, as the prayers of Isaiah do (2:6; 25:1).

decisions.choice: God addressed with "አንተ" (ሕዝብህን መራህ) from here to 64:11
decisions.reason: The prayer now speaks to God directly (meaning decision m3). In prayer the Amharic Bible says "አንተ", the closeness of children to their father, as the style guide sets; "your servants" in the prayer are "ባሪያዎችህ" (L), "አገልጋዮችህ" (B, R).

decisions.choice: "तूने": the prayer now speaks to God
decisions.reason: From here the prayer addresses God directly (meaning m3), so Hindi changes to the devotional "तू", used through 64:12.

decisions.choice: The prayer now speaks to God directly (m3): "あなた" in plain verse, with light respect forms ("導き……得られた", "ご自分の"), as ISA-1 for the people addressing God; ruach YHWH "主の霊" (ISA-2 11:2).
decisions.reason: The settled address to God in verse.

source.text: הַבֵּ֤ט מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִזְּבֻ֥ל קָדְשְׁךָ֖ וְתִפְאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ אַיֵּ֤ה קִנְאָֽתְךָ֙ וּגְב֣וּרֹתֶ֔ךָ הֲמ֥וֹן מֵעֶ֛יךָ וְֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ אֵלַ֥י הִתְאַפָּֽקוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look from heaven and see from [the] lofty dwelling of your holiness and your splendor. Where [are] your zeal and your mighty deeds? [The] stirring of your inward parts and your compassions toward me have restrained themselves.

en.L: Look from heaven and see, \q from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} lofty dwelling of holiness and splendor! \q Where [are] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} zeal and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty deeds? \q The stirring of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inner parts and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion are held back toward me.
en.B: Look down from the heavens; \q see from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} exalted dwelling, holy and splendid! \q What has become of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} zeal and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty acts? \q Your tender feeling and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion hold themselves back from me.
en.R: Look down from heaven and see us. \q Look from the holy and beautiful place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live. \q Where is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} burning love for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people? Where are the mighty things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} used to do? \q Your deep love and kindness are kept away from me.

es.L: Mira desde los cielos y ve, \q desde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} excelsa morada de santidad y de esplendor. \q ¿Dónde [están] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celo y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} proezas? \q La conmoción de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} entrañas y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión se han contenido para conmigo.
es.B: Mira desde los cielos; \q mira desde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} excelsa morada, santa y espléndida. \q ¿Qué ha sido de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celo y de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} poderosas obras? \q Tu ternura y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión se me niegan.
es.R: Mira desde el cielo y míranos. \q Mira desde el lugar santo y hermoso donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives. \q ¿Dónde está {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor ardiente por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo? ¿Dónde están las cosas poderosas que solías hacer? \q Tu profundo amor y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad se mantienen lejos de mí.

fr.L: Regarde des cieux et vois, \q de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} haute demeure de sainteté et de splendeur ! \q Où [sont] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} zèle et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} exploits ? \q Le frémissement de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} entrailles et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} compassions se retiennent envers moi.
fr.B: Regarde du haut des cieux ; \q vois, de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure élevée, sainte et splendide ! \q Que sont devenus {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} zèle et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes puissants ? \q Ta tendresse et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} compassion se refusent à moi.
fr.R: Regarde du haut du ciel et vois-nous. \q Regarde du lieu saint et magnifique où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites. \q Où est {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour ardent pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ? Où sont les grandes choses que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} faisais autrefois ? \q Ton amour profond et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté sont tenus loin de moi.

sw.L: Tazama kutoka mbinguni uone, \q kutoka makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaliyoinuka ya utakatifu na fahari! \q Uko wapi wivu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu? \q Kuugua kwa matumbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} vimezuiliwa kwangu.
sw.B: Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni; \q uone kutoka makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaliyoinuka, matakatifu na yenye fahari! \q Wivu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu yamekwenda wapi? \q Upole {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} vinajizuia mbali nami.
sw.R: Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni utuone. \q Tazama kutoka mahali patakatifu na pazuri unapoishi. \q Uko wapi upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaowaka kwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Yako wapi matendo makuu uliyokuwa ukiyafanya? \q Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mkuu na wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umezuiliwa mbali nami.

vi.L: Xin từ trời nhìn xuống và xem, \q từ nơi ngự cao cả, thánh khiết và vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Lòng nhiệt thành và những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] đâu? \q Lòng thương cảm và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị kìm giữ đối với con.
vi.B: Xin từ trên trời nhìn xuống; \q xin nhìn từ nơi ngự cao cả, thánh khiết và vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Lòng nhiệt thành và những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giờ ở đâu? \q Lòng thương cảm dịu dàng và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ngừng lại với con.
vi.R: Xin từ trời nhìn xuống và đoái xem chúng con. \q Xin nhìn xuống từ nơi thánh khiết và tươi đẹp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự. \q Tình yêu nồng cháy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đâu? Những việc quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn làm ở đâu? \q Tình thương sâu đậm và lòng nhân từ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xa cách con.

ko.L: 하늘에서 굽어보시고, \q 주님의 거룩하고 영화로운 높은 처소에서 보아 주십시오. \q 주님의 열심과 주님의 능하신 행동이 어디 있습니까? \q 주님의 애끓는 마음과 주님의 긍휼이 저에게서 그쳤습니다.
ko.B: 하늘에서 내려다보십시오. \q 거룩하고 영화로운 주님의 높은 처소에서 살펴보십시오. \q 주님의 열심과 주님의 능하신 일들은 어디로 갔습니까? \q 주님의 따뜻한 마음과 긍휼을 저에게서 거두셨습니다.
ko.R: 하늘에서 내려다보시고 저희를 보아 주십시오. \q 주님께서 계시는 거룩하고 아름다운 곳에서 보아 주십시오. \q 주님의 백성을 향한 주님의 불타는 사랑은 어디 있습니까? 주님께서 전에 하시던 놀라운 일들은 어디 있습니까? \q 주님의 깊은 사랑과 친절이 저에게서 멀어졌습니다.

pt.L: Olha dos céus e vê, \q da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} alta habitação de santidade e de esplendor! \q Onde [estão] o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} zelo e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} feitos poderosos? \q A comoção das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} entranhas e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão para comigo se contêm.
pt.B: Olha lá do céu; \q vê da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} habitação elevada, santa e esplêndida! \q Que fim levaram o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} zelo e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos poderosos? \q A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ternura e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão se retraem de mim.
pt.R: Olha lá do céu e vê como estamos. \q Olha do lugar santo e bonito onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} moras. \q Onde está o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor ardente pelo {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo? Onde estão as coisas grandiosas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} costumavas fazer? \q O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor profundo e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bondade estão longe de mim.

am.L: ከሰማይ ተመልከት፤ እይም፤ \q ከቅድስናህና ከክብርህ ከፍ ካለው ማደሪያ፤ \q ቅንዓትህና ኃያል ሥራዎችህ የት [አሉ]? \q የአንጀትህ መላወስና ርኅራኄህ ከእኔ ተከልክሏል።
am.B: ከሰማይ ወደ ታች ተመልከት፤ \q ቅዱስና ግርማ ካለው ከፍ ካለው መኖሪያህ እይ! \q ቅንዓትህና ኃያል ሥራዎችህ ምን ሆኑ? \q አንጀት የሚላውሰው ፍቅርህና ርኅራኄህ ከእኔ ተከልክለዋል።
am.R: ከሰማይ ወደ ታች ተመልከትና እየን። \q ከምትኖርበት ቅዱስና ያማረ ስፍራ ተመልከት። \q ለሕዝብህ ያለህ የሚነድ ፍቅር የት አለ? ታደርጋቸው የነበሩት ኃያላን ሥራዎች የት አሉ? \q ጥልቅ ፍቅርህና ቸርነትህ ከእኔ ርቀዋል።

hi.L: स्वर्ग से दृष्टि कर और देख, \q अपने पवित्र और वैभवशाली ऊँचे निवासस्थान से! \q तेरा उत्साह और तेरे पराक्रम के काम कहाँ [हैं]? \q तेरे भीतर की हलचल और तेरी करुणा मेरी ओर से रुकी हुई हैं।
hi.B: स्वर्ग से नीचे दृष्टि कर; \q अपने ऊँचे निवासस्थान से देख, जो पवित्र और वैभवशाली है! \q तेरा उत्साह और तेरे पराक्रम के काम कहाँ गए? \q तेरी कोमल भावना और तेरी करुणा मुझसे रुकी हुई हैं।
hi.R: स्वर्ग से नीचे देख और हमें देख। \q उस पवित्र और सुंदर स्थान से देख जहाँ तू रहता है। \q अपनी प्रजा के लिए तेरा धधकता प्रेम कहाँ है? वे महान काम कहाँ हैं जो तू किया करता था? \q तेरा गहरा प्रेम और तेरी दया मुझसे दूर रखी गई हैं।

ru.L: Посмотри с небес и увидь \q из {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} высокого жилища святости и великолепия! \q Где {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} ревность и {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} могучие дела? \q Трепет {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} нутра и {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} сострадание ко мне удерживаются.
ru.B: Взгляни с небес, \q посмотри из {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} высокого жилища, святого и великолепного! \q Где {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} ревность и {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} могучие дела? \q Твоя нежность и {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} сострадание сдерживаются и не доходят до меня.
ru.R: Посмотри с неба и увидь нас. \q Посмотри из святого и прекрасного места, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} живёшь. \q Где {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} пламенная любовь к {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} народу? Где могучие дела, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершал прежде? \q Твоя глубокая любовь и доброта удерживаются от меня.

ja.L: 天から見下ろして、見てほしい、 \q あなたの聖なる、輝かしい高い住まいから。 \q あなたの熱心と、あなたの力あるわざは、どこにあるのか。 \q あなたのはらわたのうずきと、あなたのあわれみは、わたしに対して抑えられている。
ja.B: 天から見下ろしてほしい。 \q 聖なる、輝かしい、あなたの高い住まいから見てほしい。 \q あなたの熱心と力あるわざは、どうなったのか。 \q あなたの心の奥の思いとあわれみは、わたしに向けられずに抑えられている。
ja.R: 天から見下ろして、わたしたちを見てほしい。 \q あなたが住んでおられる、聖なる美しい所から見てほしい。 \q あなたの民に向けられた、あなたの燃える熱心はどこにあるのか。あなたが以前なさった力あるわざはどこにあるのか。 \q あなたの深い愛と優しさは、わたしから遠ざけられている。

uk.L: Поглянь з небес і подивись \q з {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} високої оселі святості і краси! \q Де {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} ревність і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} могутні діла? \q Порив {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} нутра і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} милосердя стримані щодо мене.
uk.B: Поглянь з небес; \q подивись зі своєї високої оселі, святої і прекрасної! \q Що сталося з {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} ревністю і {{deity_pronoun:твоїми|Твоїми}} могутніми ділами? \q Твоя ніжність і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} милосердя стримуються від мене.
uk.R: Поглянь з неба і подивись на нас. \q Подивись зі святого і прекрасного місця, де {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} живеш. \q Де {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} палка любов до {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} народу? Де ті могутні діла, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} колись чинив? \q Твою глибоку любов і доброту тримають далеко від мене.

decisions.choice: look down from heaven, your holy dwelling: the old prayer of Israel
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 26:15 has the same prayer: "Look down from your holy dwelling, from heaven, and bless your people Israel."

decisions.choice: zeal: God's passionate commitment to his people and his name
decisions.reason: The same word is used of the LORD's zeal in 9:6, 26:11, 42:13 and 59:17, where it moves him to act for his people.

decisions.choice: the stirring of your inner parts: God's deep feeling for his people
decisions.reason: The inner organs were thought of as the seat of feeling (16:11; Jeremiah 31:20, where God's inner parts stir for Ephraim).

decisions.choice: your burning love for your people
decisions.reason: Readable explains zeal as God's strong love for his own, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: Olha lá do céu (B, R); habitação
decisions.reason: The plea echoes Deuteronomy 26:15 (m1), and Isaiah keeps that verse's Portuguese: "Olha lá do céu" (B, R) and "habitação" for God's dwelling.

decisions.choice: the stirring of your inner parts "የአንጀትህ መላወስ" (L), "አንጀት የሚላውሰው ፍቅርህ" (B)
decisions.reason: Amharic, like Hebrew, places pity in the bowels ("አንጀቱ ተላወሰ", he was moved with pity), so the Hebrew picture can be kept and still be understood (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "उत्साह" for God's zeal, as 59:17
decisions.reason: God's passionate commitment to his people (meaning m2) keeps the word used in 59:17; Readable explains it as burning love, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: habbet … ur'eh "見下ろして、見てほしい" at every level: requests to God follow ISA-1's rule ("〜てほしい", never an imperative or 〜てください), as 2:9 and 33:2.
decisions.reason: The ISA-1 rule for requests to God in the prophets.

decisions.choice: qin'atekha "あなたの熱心" (L, B), "燃える熱心" (R) (ISA-6 42:13); hamon me'ekha "はらわたのうずき" (L), "心の奥の思い" (B), "深い愛" (R), me'ayim as 16:11 (はらわた L, 心 R) (m3).
decisions.reason: The settled words.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אָבִ֔ינוּ כִּ֤י אַבְרָהָם֙ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֔נוּ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יַכִּירָ֑נוּ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אָבִ֔ינוּ גֹּאֲלֵ֥נוּ מֵֽעוֹלָ֖ם שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For you [are] our father, for Abraham does not know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us; you, Yahweh, [are] our father; our Redeemer from long ago [is] your name.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] our Father, \q though Abraham does not know us \q and Israel does not acknowledge us; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [are] our Father; \q Our Redeemer from of old [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.B: Surely {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are our Father, \q even if Abraham has never heard of us \q and Israel would not claim us as his own. \q You, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are our Father; \q from ages past {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name has been Our Redeemer.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are our Father! \q Abraham does not know who we are. \q Jacob does not recognize us as his children. \q But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are our Father. \q From long ago {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name has been Our Redeemer, the one who rescues us.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] nuestro Padre, \q aunque Abraham no nos conoce \q e Israel no nos reconoce; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [eres] nuestro Padre; \q Nuestro Redentor desde la antigüedad [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.B: Ciertamente {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres nuestro Padre, \q aunque Abraham nunca haya oído de nosotros \q e Israel no nos reconozca como suyos. \q Tú, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres nuestro Padre; \q desde tiempos antiguos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre es Nuestro Redentor.
es.R: ¡Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres nuestro Padre! \q Abraham no sabe quiénes somos. \q Jacob no nos reconoce como sus hijos. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres nuestro Padre. \q Desde hace mucho tiempo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre es Nuestro Redentor, el que nos rescata.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] notre Père, \q bien qu’Abraham ne nous connaisse pas \q et qu’Israël ne nous reconnaisse pas ; \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] notre Père ; \q « Notre Rédempteur depuis toujours », [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Oui, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es notre Père, \q même si Abraham ne nous connaît pas \q et si Israël ne nous reconnaît pas pour siens. \q Toi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es notre Père ; \q depuis toujours, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est « Notre Libérateur ».
fr.R: Mais c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es notre Père ! \q Abraham ne sait pas qui nous sommes. \q Jacob ne nous reconnaît pas comme ses enfants. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es notre Père. \q Depuis toujours, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est « Celui qui nous délivre ».

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] Baba yetu, \q ingawa Abrahamu hatujui \q na Israeli hatutambui; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [ni] Baba yetu; \q Mkombozi wetu tangu zamani [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Hakika {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Baba yetu, \q hata kama Abrahamu hajawahi kusikia habari zetu \q na Israeli hangetukubali kuwa wake. \q Wewe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni Baba yetu; \q tangu nyakati za kale jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} limekuwa Mkombozi Wetu.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Baba yetu! \q Abrahamu hajui sisi ni nani. \q Yakobo hatutambui kuwa watoto wake. \q Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni Baba yetu. \q Tangu zamani jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} limekuwa Mkombozi Wetu, yaani yule anayetuokoa.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Cha chúng con, \q dù Áp-ra-ham không biết chúng con \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên không nhận chúng con; \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Cha chúng con; \q Đấng Cứu Chuộc chúng con từ thuở xưa [là] danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con, \q dù Áp-ra-ham chẳng hề biết đến chúng con \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên không nhận chúng con là của mình. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con; \q từ thuở xa xưa danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng Cứu Chuộc Chúng Con.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con! \q Áp-ra-ham không biết chúng con là ai. \q Gia-cốp không nhận chúng con là con cái mình. \q Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con. \q Từ xưa danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng Cứu Chuộc Chúng Con, Đấng giải cứu chúng con.

ko.L: 참으로 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 아브라함은 저희를 알지 못하고, \q 이스라엘은 저희를 인정하지 않아도, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 예로부터 주님의 이름은 저희의 구속자이십니다.
ko.B: 주님은 정말로 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 아브라함이 저희를 모르고, \q 이스라엘이 저희를 자기 자손으로 인정하지 않아도, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 먼 옛날부터 주님의 이름은 '저희의 구속자'이셨습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다! \q 아브라함은 저희가 누구인지 모릅니다. \q 야곱은 저희를 자기 자녀로 알아보지 못합니다. \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 오래전부터 주님의 이름은 '저희의 구속자', 곧 저희를 구해 주시는 분이었습니다.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és] o nosso Pai, \q embora Abraão não saiba de nós \q e Israel não nos reconheça; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, [és] o nosso Pai; \q o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, desde os tempos antigos, [é] o nosso Redentor.
pt.B: Certamente {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o nosso Pai, \q mesmo que Abraão nunca tenha ouvido falar de nós \q e Israel não queira nos reconhecer como seus. \q Tu, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, és o nosso Pai; \q desde os tempos antigos o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é o nosso Redentor.
pt.R: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o nosso Pai! \q Abraão não sabe quem nós somos. \q Jacó não nos reconhece como seus filhos. \q Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, és o nosso Pai. \q Desde muito tempo atrás o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é o nosso Redentor, aquele que nos resgata.

am.L: አንተ አባታችን ነህና፤ \q አብርሃም ባያውቀን፣ \q እስራኤልም ባይቀበለን፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ አባታችን [ነህ]፤ \q ከጥንት ጀምሮ ስምህ ቤዢያችን [ነው]።
am.B: አንተ በእርግጥ አባታችን ነህ፤ \q አብርሃም ስለ እኛ ሰምቶ ባያውቅም፣ \q እስራኤልም የራሱ አድርጎ ባይቀበለንም፣ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ \q ከጥንት ዘመን ጀምሮ ስምህ ቤዢያችን ነው።
am.R: አንተ ግን አባታችን ነህ! \q አብርሃም ማን እንደ ሆንን አያውቅም። \q ያዕቆብም ልጆቹ መሆናችንን አያውቅም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ግን አባታችን ነህ። \q ከጥንት ጀምሮ ስምህ ቤዢያችን፣ የሚያድነን ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि तू हमारा पिता [है], \q यद्यपि अब्राहम हमें नहीं जानता \q और इस्राएल हमें नहीं पहचानता; \q तू, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारा पिता [है]; \q प्राचीन काल से हमारा छुटकारा दिलानेवाला तेरा नाम [है]।
hi.B: निश्चय तू ही हमारा पिता है, \q चाहे अब्राहम ने हमारे बारे में कभी न सुना हो \q और इस्राएल हमें अपना न माने। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू ही हमारा पिता है; \q युगों से तेरा नाम हमारा छुटकारा दिलानेवाला रहा है।
hi.R: पर तू ही हमारा पिता है! \q अब्राहम नहीं जानता कि हम कौन हैं। \q याकूब हमें अपनी सन्तान के रूप में नहीं पहचानता। \q पर हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू ही हमारा पिता है। \q बहुत पहले से तेरा नाम हमारा छुड़ानेवाला रहा है, वह जो हमें बचाता है।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — наш Отец, \q хотя Авраам не знает нас \q и Израиль не признаёт нас; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, — наш Отец; \q Наш Искупитель от века — {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — наш Отец, \q пусть даже Авраам не знает нас \q и Израиль не признал бы нас своими. \q Ты, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, — наш Отец; \q с древних времён {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя — Наш Искупитель.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — наш Отец! \q Авраам не знает, кто мы. \q Иаков не признаёт нас своими детьми. \q Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, — наш Отец. \q С давних времён {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя — Наш Искупитель, тот, кто спасает нас.

ja.L: まことに、あなたはわたしたちの父。 \q アブラハムがわたしたちを知らず、 \q イスラエルがわたしたちを認めなくても、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちの父。 \q 昔からの、わたしたちの贖い主、それがあなたの名。
ja.B: 確かに、あなたはわたしたちの父だ。 \q たとえアブラハムがわたしたちを知らず、 \q イスラエルがわたしたちを自分の子と認めなくても、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちの父。 \q 遠い昔から、あなたの名は、わたしたちの贖い主。
ja.R: しかし、あなたはわたしたちの父だ！ \q アブラハムは、わたしたちがだれかを知らない。 \q ヤコブは、わたしたちを自分の子孫と認めない。 \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちの父だ。 \q 昔から、あなたの名は、わたしたちを買い戻して救う方。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — наш Батько, \q хоч Авраам не знає нас \q і Ізраїль не визнає нас; \q {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, — наш Батько; \q Наш Викупитель віддавна — {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя.
uk.B: Справді, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — наш Батько, \q навіть якщо Авраам ніколи не чув про нас \q і Ізраїль не визнав би нас своїми. \q Ти, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, — наш Батько; \q з давніх віків {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя — Наш Викупитель.
uk.R: Але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — наш Батько! \q Авраам не знає, хто ми. \q Яків не визнає нас своїми дітьми. \q Але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, — наш Батько. \q Віддавна {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя — Наш Викупитель, той, хто нас рятує.

decisions.choice: you are our Father: God addressed as Father
decisions.reason: God is rarely called Father in the Old Testament, and directly addressed so only a few times (64:7; Jeremiah 3:4, 19). He is Father as the one who made and claimed Israel as his son (Deuteronomy 32:6; Exodus 4:22; Malachi 2:10).

decisions.choice: Abraham and Israel: the nation's ancestors, who cannot know or own them now
decisions.reason: Israel here is Jacob, the ancestor. Even if the founders of the nation would not recognize their descendants, God still claims them. The verbs know and acknowledge are used of a father owning his children (Deuteronomy 33:9).

decisions.choice: Redeemer: the near relative who buys back what was lost
decisions.reason: The go'el bought back family land and freed relatives from slavery (Leviticus 25:25, 47-49); God is Israel's Redeemer (41:14; 44:6).

decisions.choice: Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable names Israel the ancestor as Jacob, so the reader does not take it as the nation.

decisions.choice: SEÑOR (vocative, no "oh")
decisions.reason: YHWH addressed directly is "SEÑOR" in a divine_name span, with no "oh", as Psalm 19:15 and the terms note; book-wide in this block.

decisions.choice: Baba yetu; Ee YHWH
decisions.reason: God addressed as Father takes the capital "Baba", as in the New Testament; the vocative is "Ee BWANA", as in the published Psalms.

decisions.choice: "SEIGNEUR" in the vocative, without article
decisions.reason: The LORD addressed is `{{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}` without article and without "ô", as in the Psalms; God is addressed with "tu". Settled for chapters 41-66.

decisions.choice: God addressed as "Cha", the people as "chúng con"; "lạy CHÚA" with no "O"
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles for Isaiah 63:16 and 64:7: God is "Cha" and the people "chúng con"; the vocative LORD is "lạy CHÚA", as in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "주여" (the name in its divine_name span, with 여 outside it) and no "O" word, and "주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다"
decisions.reason: The terms note's vocative form for YHWH addressed in prayer, as Psalm 19:15; the communal prayer uses 저희.

decisions.choice: o nosso Pai (with the article, capital P); o nosso Redentor
decisions.reason: God is called Father (m1) with "o nosso Pai", the ordinary Brazilian form with the article, capitalised as a name for God, here and in 64:7; "Pai nosso" would make readers hear the Lord's Prayer. "O nosso Redentor" keeps the book's word for go'el (m3), the kinsman who buys back, as "o Redentor" in 41:14 and 59:20; Readable adds "aquele que nos resgata", the verb of Ruth's "resgatador".

decisions.choice: our Father "አባታችን"; our Redeemer "ቤዢያችን" at every level
decisions.reason: God is called Father as a title of the prayer (meaning decision m1), the word of "አባታችን ሆይ" in the Lord's Prayer. "ቤዢ" is the near relative who buys back (meaning decision m3), as 60:16; Readable adds "የሚያድነን" as the English Readable adds "the one who rescues us".

decisions.choice: "हमारा छुटकारा दिलानेवाला" (L, B); "हमारा छुड़ानेवाला" (R)
decisions.reason: The Redeemer, the near relative who buys back what was lost (meaning m3), keeps the book's forms for the title (41:14; 47:4; 60:16): "छुटकारा दिलानेवाला" at Literal and Balanced, "छुड़ानेवाला" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Отец" with a capital
decisions.reason: God addressed as Father (m1), capitalised as in the New Testament's "Отец" in prayer; the vocative of the divine name is "ГОСПОДИ" inside the setting, as in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: 'avinu "わたしたちの父" (every level), God addressed as Father (m1); go'alenu "わたしたちの贖い主" (L, B), "わたしたちを買い戻して救う方" (R), the ISA-6 go'el forms, given as the name without quotation marks; R "ヤコブ" for Israel as its English.
decisions.reason: The settled Redeemer forms.

source.text: לָ֣מָּה תַתְעֵ֤נוּ יְהוָה֙ מִדְּרָכֶ֔יךָ תַּקְשִׁ֥יחַ לִבֵּ֖נוּ מִיִּרְאָתֶ֑ךָ שׁ֚וּב לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ שִׁבְטֵ֖י נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why do you make us wander, Yahweh, from your ways, [why] do you harden our heart from fear of you? Return for [the] sake of your servants, [the] tribes of your inheritance.

en.L: Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make us wander, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways, \q [and] harden our heart from fearing {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q Return for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants, \q the tribes of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} send us straying from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} paths, \q and make our hearts so hard that we no longer fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q Turn back to us for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants, \q the tribes that belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make us wander away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways? \q Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make us so stubborn that we do not respect {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q Come back to us. Do it for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants, the tribes of Israel that belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: ¿Por qué nos haces errar, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos, \q [y] endureces nuestro corazón para que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temamos? \q Vuelve por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos, \q las tribus de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿por qué nos dejas extraviarnos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sendas, \q y endureces nuestro corazón hasta que ya no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tememos? \q Vuélvete a nosotros por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos, \q las tribus que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenecen.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿por qué nos haces alejarnos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos? \q ¿Por qué nos haces tan tercos que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} respetamos? \q Vuelve a nosotros. Hazlo por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos, las tribus de Israel que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenecen.

fr.L: Pourquoi nous fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} errer, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, loin de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} voies, \q [et] endurcis-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} notre cœur pour qu’il ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craigne pas ? \q Reviens à cause de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs, \q des tribus de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pourquoi nous laisses-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous égarer loin de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins \q et rends-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} notre cœur si dur que nous ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignons plus ? \q Reviens vers nous par égard pour {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs, \q les tribus qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiennent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pourquoi nous fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous éloigner de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins ? \q Pourquoi nous rends-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} si têtus que nous ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} respectons pas ? \q Reviens vers nous. Fais-le pour {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs, les tribus d’Israël qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiennent.

sw.L: Kwa nini, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unatufanya tutangetange mbali na njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q [na] kuufanya mgumu moyo wetu tusikuche? \q Rudi kwa ajili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kabila za urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa nini unatuacha tupotee mbali na njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q na kuifanya mioyo yetu kuwa migumu hata tusikuche tena? \q Turudie kwa ajili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kabila zilizo mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa nini unatufanya tutangetange mbali na njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}? \q Kwa nini unatufanya tuwe wakaidi hata tusikuheshimu? \q Turudie. Fanya hivyo kwa ajili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kabila za Israeli zilizo mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
